executed: Read the actual explicitly encoded V string of a fresh native BarcodeField without text transcoding or BOM removal.
DataPrep 0 preserves bytes; DataPrep 1 compresses the complete byte string once with zlib-framed Flate, without image predictors.
Partition prepared bytes into one ordered message per supplied widget; sizes differ by at most one and earlier widgets receive the remainder.
Associate each indexed message and byte offset with the actual immutable widget rectangle and serialized PMD parameters.
Invoke the explicit BarcodeImageEncoder capability; propagate failures without fabricating a symbol or mutating the field.
Create native FormAppearanceStream and AP.N with a local normalized BBox and q/cm/Do/Q image placement over the full widget rectangle.
Keep widget attachment and single-widget separate/merged representation explicit; allow reversed finite Rect corners.
Bound input/prepared bytes, widget count and cumulative generated image pixels/sample bytes; reject exhausted budgets before the next encoder call.
boundaries: No PDF417, QR Code or Data Matrix algorithm is built into the core. The external encoder owns symbology, ECC, module and quiet-zone correctness, capacity and its own allocation/work limits.
The native appearance adapter accepts normalized opaque device-colour ImageXObject samples without masks, alternate images, optional content or ancillary image resource graphs.
A non-positive or non-finite normalized Rect extent is refused by this appearance-producing operation, not declared invalid PDF rectangle syntax.
Absent V is not silently treated as empty; an explicitly empty V produces one message for every widget, and the encoder decides whether its symbology accepts it.
Page 46 permits a single merged widget while page 47 describes it as merged in the procedure. Both legal native representations are kept; no universal merge requirement is inferred.

Acrobat 9 implementation note E-7 specifies a 255-widget limit and particular flags/background. The default processing budget is 255; no universal PDF widget-count limit, flags or background is imposed.

No JavaScript calculation, automatic user-input observation, file-URL Caption discovery, encryption convention, scanner reassembly protocol or external-document rewriting is performed. A changed V requires a new explicit preparation.
